threshold_note: threshold is rolling; threshold_value is latest rolling value
strategy_description: Long SPY when lagged petroleum inventory signal is above threshold; otherwise cash.
lead_description: Signal lead = 11 month(s); L2 is the strict floor because the month's last weekly EIA print is released 0-5 days into the following month.
notes: Mode-3 Codex maker. Tournament: 13552 strategy rows plus one benchmark valid=False; 9286 valid. Winner selected by ECON-T3 at step 1; 1 tied at Sharpe step. Bootstrap p=0.0813; CP1 durability=conditionally_durable; rolling correlation=moderately_stable. Petroleum inventories are coincident physical stocks, so reverse-causality evidence is reported rather than suppressed.

selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the full monthly grid L{2..12} (9286 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.8029), scored on the deployable cash-filled series (ECON-T4). Winner raw OOS Sharpe 1.5273 at L11; the 2nd-best valid combo (petrol_6m/T3_zscore_1.0/P1_long_cash_pro/L11) sits at 1.5244. No ECON-T3 tie-break engaged (unique max on oos_sharpe). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.
